# Reprendre ici puis executer la suite. Sorties historiques conservees.
import base64, zlib, json
exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')).decode("utf-8"), globals())
for _step in json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')).decode("utf-8")):
    exec(compile(_step, "reprise_configuration", "exec"), globals())
install_resume_checks(campaign)
exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')).decode("utf-8"), globals())
activate_reduced_plan(CONFIG, globals())
RUN_TRAINING = True
RUN_FINAL_EVALUATION = True
assert torch.cuda.is_available(), "Reconnecter un runtime Colab T4."
print("GPU actif :", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))
display(dev_summary("E"))
show_training_times(globals())
_p = ROOT / "models/P_darijabert_without_both_s42"
print("Fichiers P :", {name: (_p / name).exists() for name in ("resume.pt", "weights.pt", "meta.json", ".in_progress")})
import shutil
print("Espace disponible sur le stockage Drive (Gio) :", round(shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free / 2**30, 2))
if not any((_p / name).exists() for name in ("resume.pt", "weights.pt", "meta.json")):
    raise RuntimeError("Sauvegarde P non disponible : verifier la synchronisation Drive. Aucun reentrainement depuis zero autorise ici.")
campaign.run_part("P", CONFIG)
display(dev_summary("P"))
show_training_times(globals())
